ticket.summary: Repeat kitchen line slow-drain with gurgling (3rd occurrence in 8 months, snaked Jan & May); customer declined another snake, booked camera diagnostic to find root cause.

quote_lines.description: Diagnostic visit / camera inspection of kitchen drain line

ticket.customer_message: Totally fair - camera first, and we'll only snake if the camera shows that's the right fix. You're booked for camera inspection / diagnostic (DIAG) - $89, about 1 hour, tomorrow (Tue Sep 1) at 3:00 PM at 9 Rookery Ln. If the tech recommends additional work, he'll quote it on site for your approval first. No need to do anything tonight beyond going easy on the kitchen sink; your file is flagged as a repeat kitchen-line issue with the January and May visits noted.
